note: Task 12 (chunk e3): the slap. The functions of slap.html that its README calls normative (`startSlap`, `frame`, `press`, `tensionAt`, `onMove`, `land`, `flash`, `scatter`, `SFX`, `say`, `showFace`, `preload`, `beforeLabel`, the sound's `play` / `chain` / `noise` / `thump`, the easings), its tables (`EXPR` is TUNING.practice.slap.faces; `LEAD`, `FEINT`, `SWING`, `OBSESSIVE_SPREAD` are the engine's TUNING; `SNAP`, `SWEEP`, `RETURN`, `CALM`, `EXPR_SWITCH`, `EXPR_WAIT`) and its LINES as the cardVoice rows `slap.*` by style. Module wiring beyond the listed functions (src/ui/scene/instruments/slap/slap.ts header): `performance`, `setTimeout` and `requestAnimationFrame` are the module's own (the scene's frame clock; every timer and the one frame loop are cleared by `stopSlap`), `innerWidth` / `innerHeight` are the scene frame's size, `pick` / `rand` are hashes of the slap's id and a count (no rng), `$` names the slap's own elements (in the effects layer, under the scene's UI: the stop word's pill is never covered; `npm run test:layout` checks it in `slaphold`), the scene's reply, input line and input; `LINES[style]` is built per slap from the cardVoice rows (one line picked by `voiceLine`'s hash). The sound: the prototype's world graph (a lowpass and a gain) is built in front of the sample layer's world bus and its body bus is the layer's; every source made is stopped at `stopSlap`; the room tone (the prototype's stand-in scene's) is not started. The keys: Space acts only while a slap runs and never from a field (the prototype's page-wide Space and its N / H keys are prototype only); the left button presses anywhere on the scene but on a control of its UI. `slapTimeline`, `resultOf` and `isFlick` are the timeline, the brace band and the flick as pure functions (tests/ui/practice/slapOverlay.test.ts checks `resultOf` against `tensionAt` ms by ms); the plan's `unannounced → impactAt = 500` leaves out the snap: the prototype's `lead = SNAP` wins (170 + windowMs). Shots: `npm run shots -- slap --sprite ` (the prototype sizes its `` by its layout box, which for the fixture's viewBox-only SVG is not its natural size, so the prototype side needs a PNG; the port draws the fixture SVG); the port's sprite is the scene's (110 vh, P10e), so at the same zoom it is a little larger than the prototype's 1.04 H stand-in.

differences.reason: Wiring: her face is the scene's sprite, shown through `env.setSprite(unit, label, url)` with the picture `faces` holds (the scene's answers, asked for her style's labels when the slap binds: `lookFaces`; a face whose answer comes after its moment is shown then, never lost); the prototype's own `` and its panel's "her face now" picker are prototype only. The prototype's `src !== url` check is the same test as the face now (`env.faceOf`) being another label.
No rng (Global Constraints): the noise's start offset is `rnd01()`, a hash of the slap's id and a running count, for the prototype's `Math.random()`.
No rng (Global Constraints): the pen's three scratches take their jitter from `rnd01()` (a hash of the slap's id and a count) for the prototype's `Math.random()`.

Wiring (the engine's slap instead of the prototype's scheduler): the slap is the engine's open one (`opts`: its id, its swing `windowMs` with obsessive's hashed spread already in it, its feints from her `swing`, `again`, `unannounced`, and where its answer goes); her side is `slapSide(id)` (fnv1a, R12) and cruel's second raises her hand for `TUNING.practice.slap.againLeadMs` (420, the prototype's literal). The start overlay check is prototype only. Added: the id is marked started (a redraw never starts it twice), the hash key of `rnd01` is the id, the frame loop is woken (it sleeps while nothing is drawn), and an `epoch` check after the wait for her face (a slap stopped meanwhile does not start).

differences.reason: Wiring: the answer goes to the engine at the impact, once (`s.onResult`, `practice/slap_answer`); the tally, `narrate` and `renderTally` are prototype only. With the still form (reduced motion, timing off) the camera never left, so there is no way back (`G.back` null: the prototype would jump to k = 1 and ease back, which the README's still form excludes). Cruel's second slap is the engine's (opened at once by `answerSlap`, it waits in `G.next`) and starts 120 ms after the hold as in the prototype (`startNext`); a slap that came meanwhile for another reason starts the same way. At the end of the hold the face the slap left is noted (`noteFaceLeft`), so the next slap reads her face now as the prototype's `curLabel` does.

Her hand: the line is the instruments' `.alius-her-line` (css/63-instruments.css: her hand's family and accent from the slap's `#hand`, readable mode, the still form) for the prototype's Caveat `.her-line`, at the prototype's 44 px times her hand's measured `handScale` (R10).

Wiring: the prototype's `#world` is the scene's backdrop and sprites layers, moved through `cam.draw(world, hb, k)`: the world's transform about the prototype's origin (50 % / 45 % of a box 14 % outside the frame); the backdrop grows to that 128 % box with the zoom (its 14 px blur and the motion blur divided by that growth, so on screen they are the prototype's; the scene's own light filter kept); her sprite's layer zooms from the scene's view to her face at (0.5 W, 0.42 H), geometric, from her face point measured on the drawn sprite, and takes the world's motion blur at `hb / zoom` (a filter is drawn in the scaled layer's own pixels: so on screen it is the prototype's `#her` blur); the face art takes the world's blur as is; readable mode: no blur. `cam.release()` puts every style back the moment the camera is home. The face art is the slap's `faceImg`. The reply and the input line step back only while the camera is out (so their own styles come back). The random slap and the debug readout are prototype only.
